goals.description: Identify datasource configuration, MyBatis XML and raw SQL locations, MyBatis-Plus settings, mapper packages, entities using key sequences, and SQL patterns that require MySQL-to-PostgreSQL conversion.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on establishing the migration scope. Locate configuration files, mapper XML files, raw SQL, MyBatis-Plus settings, mapper package paths, @KeySequence usages, and likely MySQL-specific SQL constructs. Do not perform conversions yet.
goals.name: Inspect migration scope

goals.description: Convert datasource URL and validation query from MySQL-style settings to PostgreSQL-compatible settings, including currentSchema when appropriate.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Update only JDBC-related configuration. Change MySQL JDBC URLs to PostgreSQL format, add currentSchema where the project needs a default schema, and replace validation queries such as SELECT 1 FROM DUAL with SELECT 1.
goals.name: Update JDBC configuration

goals.description: Replace MySQL IFNULL expressions in mapper XML or raw SQL with PostgreSQL-compatible COALESCE expressions.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on IFNULL conversions. Search SQL-bearing files for IFNULL(a, b) and convert them to COALESCE(a, b), preserving expression semantics.
goals.name: Convert IFNULL usage

goals.description: Replace MySQL DATE_FORMAT calls with PostgreSQL TO_CHAR calls, adjusting format strings where needed.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on DATE_FORMAT conversions. Replace DATE_FORMAT(date_expr, format) with TO_CHAR(date_expr, format) and verify that format tokens are valid for PostgreSQL.
goals.name: Convert DATE_FORMAT usage

goals.description: Rewrite MySQL DATE_ADD expressions using PostgreSQL interval arithmetic.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on DATE_ADD and INTERVAL syntax. Convert patterns such as DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) into PostgreSQL-style expressions such as d + INTERVAL '1 day'.
goals.name: Convert DATE_ADD intervals

goals.description: Replace MySQL CURDATE calls with PostgreSQL CURRENT_DATE where they occur in SQL.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on current-date function usage. Replace CURDATE() with CURRENT_DATE. Do not change NOW() unless there is a project-specific reason, since PostgreSQL supports it.
goals.name: Convert current date functions

goals.description: Replace casts to MySQL DATETIME with PostgreSQL TIMESTAMP casts.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on casts to DATETIME. PostgreSQL has no DATETIME type, so rewrite CAST(x AS DATETIME) as CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP), preserving the original expression.
goals.name: Convert DATETIME casts

goals.description: Replace MySQL DATE(x) date extraction/casting syntax with PostgreSQL-compatible CAST(x AS DATE).
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on DATE(x) SQL usage that acts as a cast or date extraction. Convert it to CAST(x AS DATE), taking care not to alter unrelated identifiers or function names.
goals.name: Convert DATE function casts

goals.description: Rewrite MySQL INSERT IGNORE statements using PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING syntax.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on INSERT IGNORE statements. Convert each to PostgreSQL INSERT syntax with an appropriate ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING clause, selecting the conflict target if the SQL context requires one.
goals.name: Convert INSERT IGNORE

goals.description: Rewrite MySQL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE upserts using PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE syntax.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE statements. Convert them to PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (columns) DO UPDATE SET ..., choosing conflict columns that match the relevant unique key.
goals.name: Convert duplicate-key upserts

goals.description: Rewrite MySQL multi-table UPDATE JOIN statements into PostgreSQL UPDATE ... FROM ... WHERE form.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on MySQL UPDATE statements that use JOIN syntax. Move joined tables into a PostgreSQL FROM clause, put join conditions in WHERE, and preserve existing filters and assignments.
goals.name: Convert UPDATE JOIN statements

goals.description: Adjust MyBatis-Plus logical delete values for PostgreSQL BIT columns from integer literals to BIT literals.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on MyBatis-Plus logical delete configuration. If the migrated deleted column is BIT/BIT(1), change logic-delete-value and logic-not-delete-value from 1/0 to PostgreSQL BIT literals B'1' and B'0' as string configuration values.
goals.name: Fix MyBatis-Plus BIT logic delete config

goals.description: Replace handwritten SQL comparisons against deleted = 0 or deleted = 1 with PostgreSQL BIT literals.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on handwritten SQL comparisons for deleted flags. Search mapper XML and raw SQL for deleted = 0 and deleted = 1, count all occurrences, and replace them with deleted = B'0' and deleted = B'1' where the column is a BIT/BIT(1) logical-delete field.
goals.name: Fix handwritten deleted BIT comparisons

goals.description: Ensure each MyBatis-Plus @KeySequence has a corresponding PostgreSQL sequence in the correct schema with a start value above existing table IDs.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on sequence requirements. For each @KeySequence, identify the target sequence name and schema, prepare creation or adjustment SQL, and set the sequence start value based on the current maximum table ID plus one to avoid primary key conflicts.
goals.name: Prepare PostgreSQL sequences

goals.description: Update aggregate queries so every selected non-aggregate column is either included in GROUP BY or wrapped in an appropriate aggregate function.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on GROUP BY compatibility. Inspect aggregate queries and fix selected non-aggregate columns by adding them to GROUP BY when valid, or by using appropriate aggregates such as MAX, MIN, or BOOL_OR according to business semantics.
goals.name: Fix GROUP BY strictness

goals.description: Optionally rename mapper package and namespace references from dal.mysql to dal.pg across Java directories, XML namespaces, imports, and logging configuration.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on the optional package/namespace refactor. If the migration is adopting dal.pg naming, move dal/mysql paths to dal/pg and update XML namespaces, Java imports, and application logging package configuration consistently.
goals.name: Refactor MyBatis namespace package

goals.description: Run final checks against the migration checklist and common runtime error patterns, confirming that MySQL-only constructs and known PostgreSQL incompatibilities have been addressed.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Perform final validation only. Re-scan for remaining MySQL dialect constructs and known PostgreSQL runtime-error causes: DUAL validation query, IFNULL, DATE_FORMAT, DATE_ADD, CURDATE, DATETIME casts, DATE(x), INSERT IGNORE, ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, UPDATE JOIN, integer comparisons to BIT deleted fields, missing sequences, and invalid GROUP BY selections.
goals.name: Validate PostgreSQL migration
